The post Announcing TypeScript 7.0 appeared first on TypeScript.
item.content:encoded:
Today we are proud to announce the availability of TypeScript 7, a native port of TypeScript. By bringing strong type-checking and rich tooling to the world of JavaScript, TypeScript made it possible to build non-trivial high-quality apps across platforms.

Last year, our team unveiled the next step in scaling: making every part of the compiler faster.
